title: Polygon and Points
constraintsSummary: Time limit: 3 sec; Memory limit: 1024 MiB; Constraints: 3 \leq N \leq 2\times 10^5; 1 \leq Q \leq 2\times 10^5; -10^9 \leq X_i,Y_i,A_i,B_i \leq 10^9; S is a strictly convex N-gon. That is, its interior angles are all less than 180 degrees.; (X_1,Y_1),\ldots,(X_N,Y_N) are the vertices of S in counter-clockwise order.; All values in the input are integers.
